result.summary: Kessler Traders GmbH currently has an invoice 40 days past due (INV001567, €86,900) alongside two invoices not yet due, totaling €189,100 in open exposure against a €430,000 credit limit (44% utilization). Settled history shows heavy lateness (46 and 55 days) followed by a brief improvement to 10 days late, but the current 40-day overdue invoice signals a reversion to slow payment. Underwriters should monitor closely given the pattern of recurring severe delinquency despite occasional improvement.
